name: Arkitekt
description: The apps the Arkitekt team publishes. Listing an app here makes it easy to find; a release is still approved on your hub before it is deployed.

entries.name: Basiks
entries.description: The standard library: small, general actions over mikro data that a workflow strings together between the specialised apps.

entries.name: OME Converter
entries.description: Converts any file Bio-Formats can read (czi, lif, nd2, ome-tiff, ...) into mikro datasets, one pyramided dataset per series.

entries.name: OME-TIFF Converter
entries.description: Converts OME-TIFF files (and plain TIFFs) into mikro datasets natively, with their OME metadata. No Bio-Formats, no JVM.

entries.name: LIF Converter
entries.description: Converts Leica LIF and LOF files into mikro datasets natively, one pyramided dataset per image (and per tile of a tile scan).

entries.name: ND2 Converter
entries.description: Converts Nikon ND2 files into mikro datasets natively, with NIS-Elements' own metadata, one dataset per stage position.

entries.name: OBF Reader
entries.description: Converts Imspector OBF/MSR files into mikro datasets, one per acquisition.

entries.name: SNT Traces Importer
entries.description: Imports SNT (Simple Neurite Tracer) .traces files as mikro annotation collections.

entries.name: HoverFast
entries.description: HoverFast nuclei segmentation of H&E images: a label mask of the nuclei on the image's own grid. CPU and CUDA flavours.

entries.name: Segment Anything Along Path
entries.description: Segment Anything along a path drawn in the 3D scene: trace an axon, vessel or fibre and get back a label crop and, if asked, a surface.

entries.name: nnInteractive Along Path
entries.description: nnInteractive along a path drawn in the 3D scene: trace an axon, vessel or fibre and get back a label crop and, if asked, a surface. Needs a GPU.

entries.name: AIS Organelles
entries.description: Segments the axon initial segment and the cisternal organelle inside it along a path drawn in the 3D scene.

entries.name: Kaller
entries.description: A room assistant that runs actions: asked to segment something, it finds an installed segmenter, fills in the image from the room and calls it.

entries.name: Fairino Controller
entries.description: A simulated Fairino FR5 robot arm with a live 3D view: click the floor and it solves the joint angles to go there.

entries.name: String Operations
entries.description: Simple string operations, written in the App pattern: a minimal example of an Arkitekt app.
